senses.sense_definition: The absence of belief in the existence of deities, or the positive belief that no deities exist.

examples.text: His philosophical journey led him from devout faith to outspoken <w>atheism</w>.
The debate centered on whether modern <w>atheism</w> is merely a lack of belief or an active worldview.

senses.sense_definition: The rejection of all religions, including non-theistic spiritual systems and doctrines.

examples.text: The regime promoted scientific <w>atheism</w> and systematically suppressed both traditional churches and Buddhist temples.
Her strict form of <w>atheism</w> dismissed all spiritual traditions as unscientific nonsense.

senses.sense_definition: The refusal to worship or believe in the traditional gods of a specific society or state.

examples.text: Early Christians in Rome were often executed for <w>atheism</w> because they refused to venerate imperial gods.
Socrates was accused of impiety and <w>atheism</w> for neglecting the recognized deities of Athens.

traits.comment: Historical usage describing nonconformity to state or civic religion.
